facts.text: SPAMB drives a syringe pump, a 10-position selector valve and two solenoid valves over serial
PumpController selects MockPump when mock=True and the Chemyx adapter otherwise
set_diameter takes the syringe inner diameter in mm
set_rate takes the flow rate in mL/min
set_volume takes the target volume in mL and sends a negative volume for withdraw
get_status reports is_running, rate, target_volume, dispensed_volume, volume_remaining, diameter and direction
stop() sends the pump stop command for the configured pump number and clears the running state
A command is sent as the command text plus a carriage return
A response is complete at the '>' prompt
In multipump mode a 'set' command is prefixed with the pump number
The pump must be in Multi-Step Mode to accept computer commands
The 60 mL BD plastic syringe of the example configuration has a 26.59 mm inner diameter
The example configuration declares a 50000 uL syringe capacity and a 45000 uL warning threshold
The README gives a configured flow rate range of 1 to 50000 uL/min and tells the operator to confirm the real limits for the pump and syringe
The pump-hardware notes use a 10 mL syringe with diameter 14.5 mm, rate 1.0 mL/min and volume 5.0 mL in an example

operator_required.name: target_volume
operator_required.reason: the deliverable volume depends on the installed syringe; the clone states only example syringe capacities, never a bound of the pump (fluidics-control/README.md:130-132); the site supplies the range

operator_required.name: syringe_diameter
operator_required.reason: the syringe diameter is a property of the installed syringe; the clone shows example diameters (fluidics-control/README.md:130, docs/pump-hardware.md:41) but no device bound; the site supplies the range
